text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex was almost certainly not a factor in choosing between you. An all-female panel selecting a female applicant does not indicate unlawful sex discrimination, and bringing up the panel's gender composition would damage your professional credibility.

Instead, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. Panels frequently evaluate factors beyond paper qualifications, such as interview performance, institutional vision, references, or school fit. If any improper bias occurred, it would more plausibly involve internal politics or age rather than sex. Focus strictly on understanding the objective criteria used for the appointment.
